correctness.rationale: For every vector, its sorted-magnitude layer-cake decomposition expresses it as a positive sum of signed support indicators with exactly matching Lorentz norm; triangle inequality reduces the norm to a finite signed-step optimization. A support with k<n and q arcs has b<=k-q internal sign changes and exactly 2q boundary edges, yielding norm W_b+W_{b+2q}<=W_{k-1}+W_{k+1}, with equality by one alternating arc. Full supports produce n edges of magnitude2 exactly for even cycles and at most n-1 for odd cycles. Concavity and AM–GM prove the power-weight branch and Taylor gives its defect. The code has separate rational checks, not an infinite proof.
